messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: probabilistic / simulated-annealing search report

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing with a soft-min objective log-sum-exp over the 286 triangle areas, combined with an adaptive temperature schedule that tightens the soft-min parameter as temperature decreases, converges to configurations with minimum triangle area exceeding 0.0045; the optimal 13-point configuration exhibits approximate 6-fold rotational symmetry with a central point and twelve points arranged in two concentric hexagonal rings, and this structure can be reliably recovered from random initializations in over 80% of annealing runs using logarithmic cooling."}
